title: Replace mock heartbeat chart with real data in WorkerDetailDrawer
description:
WorkerDetailDrawer.tsx has a heartbeat chart that uses synthetic random data (5-min intervals, random values). Replace with real heartbeat timestamps from the worker data.

**Implementation:**
- The `useWorkers()` hook returns heartbeat data. Use the worker's `lastHeartbeat` timestamp and build a timeline from event store data if available.
- If historical heartbeat data isn't available from backend, show "last seen X ago" indicator instead of fake chart
- Remove the mock data generation code

**Files:** `dashboard/src/components/agents/WorkerDetailDrawer.tsx`
definitionOfDone: Heartbeat visualization uses real data or shows accurate last-seen indicator

implementationPlan.description:
Update dashboard/src/components/agents/WorkerDetailDrawer.tsx:
1. Delete the mock `heartbeatTimeline()` function (lines 82-95)
2. Remove unused Recharts imports (LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip) and the `hbData` variable
3. Replace the Heartbeat Chart section (lines 194-226) with a "Last Seen" indicator card: show relative time prominently (e.g. '12s ago'), color-coded status dot (green if < 30s, yellow if < 2min, red if > 2min or missing), and the raw ISO timestamp in muted text below. Keep the section header 'Heartbeat Status'.
implementationPlan.note: Removed mock heartbeatTimeline(), Recharts imports, and hbData. Replaced chart with real heartbeatAge() function: computes seconds since last heartbeat, color-coded dot (green <30s, yellow <2min, red >2min), shows relative time + raw ISO timestamp. No-data fallback message.
